skill.name: dev-servers
skill.description: Start a FastAPI backend and Vite frontend for local development, including dependency checks and port warnings.
skill.summary: Launch backend and frontend development servers for a local app.
skill.author: AppleLamps

security_audit.summary: The static command findings are mostly expected for a skill that starts local development servers. Dependency installation and environment file checks remain real risks because they can run package manager commands and interact with secret configuration.

remediation.issue: Dependency installation commands can execute package lifecycle scripts.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the existing user confirmation step and make clear that package installs should only run in trusted repositories.

remediation.issue: Checking .env for OPENAI_API_KEY can expose sensitive configuration if the file contents are displayed.
remediation.suggestion: Verify only the key presence and never print the value or full .env file contents.

content.value_statement: Starting multi-service apps often requires repeated setup checks and commands. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through backend and frontend startup steps.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether backend and frontend dependencies appear installed.
Prompts for user confirmation before installing missing dependencies.
Starts a FastAPI backend with uvicorn reload mode.
Starts a Vite frontend development server.
Warns when expected development ports may already be in use.
Reminds the agent not to expose the OPENAI_API_KEY.
limitations: Assumes backend and frontend directories use the documented names.
Does not define project-specific health checks after startup.
Requires a valid Python environment and Node installation.
Cannot safely create or reveal secret values in environment files.

use_cases.description: Use the skill to launch both backend and frontend services during feature development.

use_cases.title: Prepare a repository for local testing
use_cases.description: Use the dependency checks before running a project for the first time.

use_cases.title: Run an app before manual verification

prompt_templates.title: Start the app
prompt_templates.prompt: Start the dev servers for this project.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for the default local startup flow.

prompt_templates.title: Check setup first
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether the backend and frontend dependencies are installed, then start the dev servers if everything is ready.
prompt_templates.scenario: User wants a safe setup check before running commands.

prompt_templates.title: Install missing dependencies with confirmation
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare the backend and frontend for local development. Ask before installing missing dependencies, then launch both servers.
prompt_templates.scenario: Repository may not have all dependencies installed yet.

prompt_templates.title: Launch and report ports
prompt_templates.prompt: Start the FastAPI and Vite development servers in the background, warn me about port conflicts, and report the local URLs when ready.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced startup request with background execution and status reporting.

output_examples.output: The backend server is starting on localhost port 8000, and the frontend server is starting on localhost port 5173. I will report any startup errors.

output_examples.input: Run the app locally, but do not install anything without asking.
output_examples.output: I checked the expected dependency folders. The frontend dependencies are missing, so I will ask for approval before running the install step.

output_examples.input: Launch backend and frontend for manual testing.
output_examples.output: Both services are being launched for local testing. If either expected port is already in use, I will warn you before continuing.

best_practices: Review install commands before approving them in unfamiliar repositories.
Keep environment files private and verify only that required keys exist.
Stop background development servers when testing is complete.
anti_patterns: Do not print .env contents or secret values into the chat.
Do not run package installs in an untrusted repository without review.
Do not assume localhost ports are free without checking conflicts.

faq.question: What does this skill start?
faq.answer: It starts a FastAPI backend with uvicorn and a Vite frontend with npm run dev.

faq.question: Does it install dependencies automatically?
faq.answer: It should ask before installing missing backend or frontend dependencies.

faq.question: Which ports does it expect?
faq.answer: It expects the backend on localhost port 8000 and the frontend on localhost port 5173.

faq.question: Can it manage secrets?
faq.answer: It can remind the agent to check that a key exists, but it must not reveal secret values.

faq.question: Is this only for Claude Code?
faq.answer: No. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I do if a port is in use?
faq.answer: Stop the conflicting process or configure the project to use a different local port.
